description.value: Masala Roots is a family-operated Indian kitchen run by a husband-and-wife team with over 17 years of culinary experience, specializing in bold, authentic North Indian flavors prepared fresh daily with no additives. Originally established in Brentwood Bay, the business has since relocated its main restaurant to View Royal while retaining a food truck presence in the Brentwood Bay area. The takeaway-focused menu spans North Indian street food, curries, tandoor breads, and kebabs, with clear vegetarian and gluten-free options marked throughout.
